menu_options.matter: Matter / multi-button remote (one event entity per button)

device.title: Pick device
device.description: Pick the device whose buttons you want to map.

matter.title: Pick Matter remote
matter.description: Pick a remote that exposes one event.* entity per button (typical for Matter). Every button × event becomes a slot, named button:event (e.g. button_1:long_press).

actions.title: Button actions
actions.description: Found {found} action(s) on {device}. Zigbee2MQTT publishes an action only after its button has been pressed once — press each button/gesture now, enable "Probe again", and submit to refresh. You can also type action ids manually (e.g. 1_single, 1_hold).

z2m_topic.title: Zigbee2MQTT raw topic
z2m_topic.description: The device topic, e.g. zigbee2mqtt/bedroom_remote. Type the action ids the remote publishes (press buttons and watch the topic to find them).

event_entity.title: Event entity
event_entity.description: Actions default to the entity's event_types; override to rename.

mqtt_generic.title: Generic MQTT
mqtt_generic.description: Any topic publishing button events. The optional template extracts the action id from the payload (e.g. {{ value_json.button }}); without it the raw payload is the id.

error.no_actions: No actions given. Press each button and probe again, or enter action ids manually.
error.no_event_entities: That device has no event.* entities. Pick a device whose buttons appear as event entities, or use another source type.

abort.already_in_progress: This remote is already being set up in another dialog. Finish or close that one first.

data.owned_scene_cleanup: When clearing a slot with an owned scene/automation

data_description.owned_scene_cleanup: ask = confirm each time; always_delete / never_delete = remembered choice (set here to reset).
